offering_description.value: IES installs electrical, HVAC and plumbing systems for homebuilders and apartment developers, and builds network and communications infrastructure for data center operators and other enterprises. It also provides electrical and mechanical contracting for commercial and industrial facilities. Its workshops build custom power equipment and repair industrial motors and generators.

primary_products.value: Generator enclosures; packaged power systems; bus duct

primary_services.value: Residential electrical installation; data center network installation; residential HVAC and plumbing installation; commercial and industrial electrical and mechanical contracting; motor and generator repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: Homebuilders, apartment developers, data center operators, general contractors, commercial property owners and industrial operators; B2G: Public agencies commissioning electrical work for their facilities

end_markets.value: Residential construction; data centers; commercial and institutional construction; industrial facilities; power generation and distribution

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Electrical, communications, HVAC, plumbing and mechanical design and installation; product sales: Custom generator enclosures and power distribution equipment; service fees: Electrical and mechanical maintenance and motor and generator repair
revenue_model.category: project or contract; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses purchased materials and equipment to install building systems and networks and repair machinery for builders and facility operators; OEM / manufacturer: Fabricates and assembles custom power equipment for generator suppliers, data centers and industrial customers

geography_served.value: US national: Operations across the United States, with residential trades concentrated in selected regional markets

specialization.value: related lines: Residential trades, data center communications, commercial and industrial contracting, custom power equipment and electromechanical repair

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Regional contracting offices, project bids and direct orders from builders, data center operators and industrial customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Electrical and mechanical contracting subject to state and local trade licensing, building codes and OSHA safety rules

notes: The current relative size of the residential and communications segments is uncertain.
